dossier.purpose: Fact record for the Arch Linux image offered in Microsoft's WSL distribution manifest (microsoft/WSL, distributions/DistributionInfo.json). Entry ModernDistributions.archlinux[0] (Name 'archlinux', FriendlyName 'Arch Linux') names one x86-64-only image: https://fastly.mirror.pkgbuild.com/wsl/2026.10.01.179549/archlinux-2026.10.01.179549.wsl with SHA-256 d2ef183f58cd65bfce52d5a122fe4936f7f2ac0af6b1b427681afd28d1f64b17. The manifest's own top-level Default is 'Ubuntu', not Arch. Pages-only study: the working directory held only .round-meta.json, the manifest was read via WebFetch, and the second listed page (Arch wiki 'Install Arch Linux on WSL') returned an Anubis 'Access Denied' page on all three attempts, so none of its content (install steps, systemd, GPU, keyring) is covered.

claims.claim: Arch Linux is a ModernDistributions record under family key 'archlinux' (a one-element array): Name 'archlinux', FriendlyName 'Arch Linux', Default true. What 'Default' means is not documented on the opened pages; in every multi-entry family (Ubuntu, openSUSE, RLCPlus, SUSE, AlmaLinux, Fedora) exactly one entry has Default true and the others have false.

Image location: Amd64Url.Url is https://fastly.mirror.pkgbuild.com/wsl/2026.10.01.179549/archlinux-2026.10.01.179549.wsl, a .wsl file whose path and file name carry the build string 2026.10.01.179549.
Published checksum: Amd64Url.Sha256 is d2ef183f58cd65bfce52d5a122fe4936f7f2ac0af6b1b427681afd28d1f64b17 (64 hex characters).
Only an Amd64Url exists for Arch; the entry has no Arm64Url key.
The only keys used by ModernDistributions entries are Name, FriendlyName, Default, Amd64Url, Arm64Url, Url and Sha256: there is no signature, GPG, version, support-window or minimum-WSL-version key.
Top-level keys are ModernDistributions, Default and Distributions; the top-level Default is the string 'Ubuntu'.

The legacy top-level Distributions array (Ubuntu, Debian, kali-linux, OracleLinux_7_9, OracleLinux_8_10, OracleLinux_9_5, SUSE-Linux-Enterprise-15-SP6, openSUSE-Tumbleweed; Store-style fields such as StoreAppId and PackageFamilyName) has no Arch entry; Arch appears only under ModernDistributions.

Gap, not a project statement: the listed install page returned an Anubis page headed 'Oh noes!' with 'Access Denied: error code 9e4edb5b6b850c41' (Anubis v1.27.0), so no statement from the Arch wiki was read.

claim_checks.claim: Need: installed from a vendor image whose checksum can be verified.
claim_checks.evidence: The Arch entry carries Amd64Url.Sha256 = d2ef183f58cd65bfce52d5a122fe4936f7f2ac0af6b1b427681afd28d1f64b17, identical in three separate WebFetch passes (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json, ModernDistributions.archlinux[0]), so a checksum exists to compare against. Not confirmed: the .wsl file was not downloaded or hashed; WebFetch returns processed text rather than raw bytes; the checksum is published in Microsoft's manifest, not on an Arch page I could read; and the entry has no signature or attestation key.

claim_checks.claim: Need: the image comes from the Arch vendor.
claim_checks.evidence: Amd64Url.Url has host fastly.mirror.pkgbuild.com and path /wsl/2026.10.01.179549/ (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json). Neither opened page states that this host is the Arch project's official release location; the wiki page that might say so returned Access Denied (https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Install_Arch_Linux_on_WSL).

claim_checks.claim: Need: a single base distribution image is identified for Arch.
claim_checks.evidence: The 'archlinux' family key holds exactly one entry (Name 'archlinux', one Amd64Url) and the legacy Distributions array has no Arch entry (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json). Only the build string 2026.10.01.179549 in the URL identifies the version.

claim_checks.claim: Need: an image usable on an x86-64 Windows host (RTX 4090 machine).

'Default': true appears once per family, including on the single-entry Arch family, and its semantics are not documented on the opened pages (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json).

claim_checks.claim: Need: systemd user services work in the image.
claim_checks.evidence: No systemd text exists in the manifest entry, and the Arch wiki page returned Access Denied (https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Install_Arch_Linux_on_WSL). The image contents were not inspected.

claim_checks.evidence: The manifest lists no package versions (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json); the wiki page was unreadable and the image was not opened.

claim_checks.claim: Need: NVIDIA GPU access through WSL for an RTX 4090.
claim_checks.evidence: No GPU, NVIDIA or CUDA key or text exists in the manifest entry; the wiki page returned Access Denied (https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Install_Arch_Linux_on_WSL).

The Arch entry has no version, LTS, support-window or end-of-support key and its FriendlyName is plain 'Arch Linux' (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json). The wiki page that might state a support policy was unreadable.

claim_checks.claim: Need: the .wsl image works with WSL 2.7.13 and kernel 6.18.
claim_checks.evidence: The entry has no minimum-WSL-version or kernel key; the only format hint is the .wsl extension in Amd64Url.Url (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json). The wiki page was unreadable.

risks: Coverage gap: https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Install_Arch_Linux_on_WSL returned an Anubis 'Oh noes!' / 'Access Denied' page (error code 9e4edb5b6b850c41, Anubis v1.27.0) on all three attempts (later attempts may have been fetch-cache hits). Its install steps, pacman keyring, systemd, GPU and warning text were not read, so every need beyond checksum presence and architecture is unverified. No alternate URL was used, because only the listed pages were allowed.

Snapshot only: the manifest is read from branch master with no pinned tag or commit (.round-meta.json:8-9), and the Arch entry pins one dated build (2026.10.01.179549, read 2026-10-02). The URL and SHA-256 recorded here will differ whenever the entry is updated (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json).

Thin integrity evidence: the entry gives only a SHA-256 held in Microsoft's manifest; no signature, GPG or attestation key exists in any ModernDistributions entry. All manifest values were read through WebFetch (processed text, not raw bytes); the hash matched across three passes but the image was never downloaded or hashed here (same manifest URL).
x86-64 only: the Arch entry has no Arm64Url (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json, ModernDistributions.archlinux[0]).

No lifecycle data: the entry carries no version-support, LTS or minimum-WSL-version key and its FriendlyName is plain 'Arch Linux', so 'long-term security support' and WSL 2.7.13 compatibility cannot be evidenced from the manifest (same manifest URL).

Download provenance: the image is served from fastly.mirror.pkgbuild.com; the opened pages do not say who operates that host or that it is the Arch project's official release channel, and the wiki that might was unreadable (manifest URL above; wiki URL returned Access Denied).

Possible misreading of selection: the manifest's top-level Default is 'Ubuntu'; Arch's 'Default': true only marks its own single-entry family, and the flag's semantics are undocumented on the opened pages (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/WSL/master/distributions/DistributionInfo.json).

Licensing unexamined: the working directory contains only .round-meta.json and no license file, so license.spdx is null; neither the manifest repository's license nor the image's package licences were opened.
